name: tomx
description: A young Latino man, 185 cm, LANKY: long legs, a narrow chest, slim arms with a little shape, shoulders slightly broader than a skinny boy's, and a small soft belly that rounds his T-shirt at the waist and shows as a soft curve above the belt in side views. LIGHT BROWN sun-tanned skin (a light tan, clearly not dark). Dark brown hair cropped short with loose curls on top. Dark brown heavy-lidded eyes, a wide easy mouth, light stubble along the jaw. His palms are noticeably lighter, bleached by solvent. A stack of steel bearing rings on his LEFT wrist ONLY - never on the right. One small brass ear stud. Age 21, OUTFIT (the parts stall): a closed sleeveless gilet in matte charcoal with an oil-slick iridescent sheen and a stand-up collar, ACID-YELLOW rigging tape wound around both shoulder seams, over a plain white short-sleeved T-shirt that shows below the gilet's hem; a brown leather tool harness - one diagonal strap over his RIGHT shoulder across the chest with small brass canisters, and a belt strap at the back; olive-grey cargo trousers with side pockets and shiny, worn copper-brown knee patches; worn brown leather lace-up work boots with a glossy, mottled finish. BOTH HANDS EMPTY in every view unless the pose itself uses them: nothing held, no props. No hat, no glasses, no watch, no gloves, no tattoos. PRONOUNS: the view library's prompts say 'she/her'; this character is a MAN - every view must be drawn as him (see _next_session).
